entries.zh: 亿万；数不清，不可胜数
entries.en: innumerable, countless (myriads)

entries.zh: 千头万绪；多端，种种不一
entries.en: in every way; myriad, of countless kinds

entries.zh: 万物；一切事物
entries.en: all things, all creation

entries.zh: 巷：里巷、街巷（西语释义为搅扰、不安，与汉字义不合，存疑）
entries.en: lane, alley; doubtful — Spanish gloss “to disturb / restless” does not match the Chinese
entries.notes: M 栏声调标注污损（T99），汉字巷（巷道义）与西语 inquietar 义不合，疑缺损或误配。

entries.zh: 掩：遮盖、掩藏；下附例句内嵌西语 abaxo（下面），语义残缺难解，存疑
entries.en: to cover, conceal; example phrase follows with embedded Spanish “abaxo” (below), partly illegible — doubtful
entries.notes: 例句 gian xiau do so abaxo utalhuyad 无法完整解读，且掩与词头 ynquietar 义不合，疑有缺损。

entries.zh: 儀：仪度、仪容（西语释义为搅扰，与汉字义不合）；下附例句残缺，存疑
entries.en: bearing, demeanor(?); doubtful — Spanish gloss “to disturb” does not match; example phrase partly illegible
entries.notes: 汉字儀与词头 ynquietar 义不合，例句 I cho lang: cho mo 难解，疑有缺损。

entries.zh: 喧噪、吵闹；（心神）烦乱不安
entries.en: noisy, clamorous; restless and unquiet in spirit

entries.zh: 纷乱；（心绪）乱、不宁
entries.en: confused, disordered; unsettled heart

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语栏为空、汉字存疑（珆/殆），仅余闽南语音写 fai，材料不足。

entries.zh: 吵嚷、喧闹；不得安宁
entries.en: clamorous, shouting; restless, without peace

entries.zh: 烦乱不安、惶惶不宁（据西语释义）；汉字掩散与音写不合，存疑
entries.en: restless, uneasy (per Spanish gloss); Chinese compound “掩散” doubtful, does not match the romanization
entries.notes: 音写 guiau çoa 与汉字掩散不合（散当音 soa），词义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 浸注：浸泡灌注（与西语释义不合，存疑）
entries.en: to soak and pour into; doubtful — Spanish form ynquiess (inquietar family) does not match
entries.notes: 汉字浸注（浸泡灌注）与 ynquiess（inquietar 族词）义不合，疑误配或缺损。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（巷兒家/巷完家），M 栏声调污损（T99），无法定夺。

entries.zh: 心烦意乱、内心躁动（炒为躁/吵之俗写）
entries.en: troubled, agitated in mind; turbulent, troublesome
entries.notes: 炒依音写 chau 与西语 inquieto revoluso 推定为躁/吵之俗写。

entries.zh: 心烦意乱、肝肠不宁（为事务所扰；炒为躁之俗写）
entries.en: heart disquieted with business and affairs; inner turmoil
entries.notes: 炒依音写与西语释义推定为躁之俗写；negocios 指事务、生意。

entries.zh: 坐立不安，东站西站，无处安顿
entries.en: restless, settling nowhere, standing now east now west; fidgety
entries.notes: 西语 no afiencia 推定为 afincarse（安顿）之残写，与立東立西互证。

entries.zh: 学霸：学堂里的恶霸、搅闹学堂之人（17 世纪义，非现代优等生义）
entries.en: school bully; one who stirs up trouble at school (霸 as tyrant, not modern top-student sense)

entries.zh: 惊慌、仓皇不安
entries.en: flustered, panicked; in disquiet
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（悽惶/愴惶），音写 chong hong 更近倉皇，据以释为惊慌不安。

entries.zh: 心动不宁（汉字作慈心動，恻隐之心发动；与西语心乱无序不合，存疑）
entries.en: heart stirred — Chinese reads “compassion moved”, Spanish gloss reads “heart disturbed, in disorder”; mismatch, doubtful
entries.notes: 慈与音写 ios 及西语 desorden 均不合，疑缺损或误读。

entries.zh: 造谣生事、扬人恶行（levantar falso，诬告中伤）；臭行，声名狼藉之行
entries.en: to stir up trouble by slander, raising a false report; infamous conduct of ill repute
